snippet.title: Metal Crash - Hard Hatters stage
snippet.description:
Lemme actually make this video public now, I was sorta worried about doing so earlier. This was a quick lil project for SAGE 2024, semi-revival of an old fangame I had worked on back in 2010.

Btw no, this isn't a "Crash N Tense replacement", N Tense is what replaced this originally. I'm not currently planning on doing more than the two stages of the "demo" for Metal Crash, haven't touched it again since SAGE 2024. Back in 2010 or so my plans were to have this sorta big world adventure games, mixing vibes of Metal Slug, Ratchet & Clank, and Jak & Daxter, but yeeeah hah, was a bit of a mess in the long run, and back then I never made more than a single test level. Was fun actually turning things more playable finally.

Do still wanna get back to properly working on N Tense too, I've just been struggling with keeping up with bigger projects, shorter ones and RAGE projects been fitting me a bit better these recent years. Plus Sonic Only Up, somethin about building the areas for that has just been very fun.

In other news, currently waiting for Shadow R x Tekken DX to be approved on SFGHQ (so that it's available for download again), aaand RAGE site has my newest lil game, Sonic Advance 74, up for download. That will get a DX version eventually as well.

Anyway, play Metal Crash demo by downloading it from here - https://sonicfangameshq.com/forums/showcase/metal-crash-2-stage-pack.2277/
